name: tokenspeed
description: TokenSpeed is a speed-of-light LLM inference engine.
one_liner: Software that runs AI language models faster and cheaper on the same computer hardware, aimed at companies that serve those models to lots of users.
buyer: An AI infrastructure or platform team at a company that runs its own large language models at scale and pays heavily for GPU time.
business_use_cases: A company serving its own fine-tuned model to customers swaps in TokenSpeed to serve more requests per GPU, directly lowering their cloud compute bill.
A cloud GPU provider offers 'TokenSpeed-optimized' hosting as a premium tier, charging a markup for faster, cheaper-per-token inference than standard setups.
An infrastructure consultancy sells a one-off migration service helping companies move their inference stack onto it to cut costs.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed, pre-tuned hosting service built on it, billed by tokens served, undercutting standard inference providers on price.
Sell migration and tuning consulting to companies with existing inference infrastructure who want the cost savings without doing the integration themselves.

steal_this: This is deep infra for companies already running their own models at real scale; there's no realistic weekend consumer product here, only a consulting/hosting angle for teams who already have the GPU bill to justify it.
